```flowproof
# Five isolated attempts graded by frozen tests; choose by tests, then behaviour, then exact patch votes, falling back to the first candidate.
workflow fix_and_pick
  needs issue: text
  role author can edit
  budget at most 40 credits, 5 calls

  fork 5 isolated into attempts
    let patch = edit author: """
      Fix this issue: {issue}
      Attempt {branch} of 5.
      """
    keep patch
  end

  let graded = test attempts with "npm test" frozen "test/**", "package.json"
  let best = choose graded by tests, then behaviour, then exact patch votes else first
  give best
end
```
